content:
Roblox is a platform for creating and playing interactive experiences.

Luau is the scripting language used by Roblox.

Workspace contains objects that exist in the 3D world.

Players is a Roblox service that manages players in an experience.

ServerScriptService is used for server-side scripts.

ReplicatedStorage stores objects that can be accessed by both the server and clients.

A Part is a physical object in a Roblox experience.

Vector3 represents a three-dimensional vector.

CFrame represents position and orientation in three-dimensional space.

Instance.new creates a new Roblox instance.

Parent determines where an Instance exists in the Roblox hierarchy.

A Script normally runs on the server.

A LocalScript normally runs on the client.

A ModuleScript contains reusable Luau code.

game:GetService is used to retrieve Roblox services.

Players.PlayerAdded fires when a player joins the experience.

Players.PlayerRemoving fires when a player leaves.

A Player object represents a connected player.

A RemoteEvent is used for communication between the server and clients.

RemoteFunction allows a client and server to communicate with a return value.

Important gameplay state should be controlled by the server.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    print(player.Name .. " joined the game!")
end)

local part = Instance.new("Part")
part.Size = Vector3.new(4, 1, 4)
part.Position = Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
part.Parent = workspace

Roblox events use Connect to run a function when an event fires.

Example:

part.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
    print(hit.Name)
end)

Attributes allow Instances to store custom values.

SetAttribute creates or changes an attribute.

GetAttribute reads an attribute from an Instance.

CollectionService allows groups of Instances to be tagged.

Tags can be used to identify objects that share behavior.

Roblox characters and rigs can use animation systems.

An Animator can load AnimationTracks.

AnimationTrack:Play starts an animation.

AnimationTrack:Stop stops an animation.

A Humanoid controls character behavior.

Humanoid:MoveTo can request movement toward a position.

Humanoid health determines whether a character is alive.

CFrame can represent both position and orientation.

CFrame.new creates a CFrame.

CFrame.Angles creates rotations using radians.

CFrame multiplication can combine transformations.

Vector3.new creates a three-dimensional vector.

Vector3 magnitude describes vector length.

Unit returns a normalized vector when the magnitude is nonzero.

ServerScriptService is intended for server-side game logic.

The server should validate important client requests.

Clients should not be trusted with authoritative rewards or inventory changes.

LocalScripts can handle player input, camera behavior and local UI.

Player-specific presentation can often be handled on the client.

Client code should communicate with the server through approved remotes.

ScreenGui contains Roblox user interface objects.

TextLabel displays text.

TextButton provides a clickable button.

UIListLayout can arrange GUI elements automatically.

Folder instances can organize Roblox objects.

ReplicatedStorage can contain shared modules, remotes and assets.

Workspace contains objects in the 3D world.

print can display debugging information.

warn displays warning information.

The Roblox Developer Console can be used to inspect runtime output and errors.

Avoid unnecessary work every frame.

Use events when possible instead of constantly polling.

Large numbers of expensive operations can reduce performance.

BaseParts have physical properties.

Anchored prevents a part from being moved by physics.

CanCollide controls whether physical collision occurs.

Workspace:Raycast can detect objects along a ray.

RaycastParams can configure filtering behavior.

Raycasting is useful for ground detection, targeting and visibility checks.

DataStoreService can persist player data between sessions.

Important saved data should be validated before being written.

DataStore operations can fail and should be handled appropriately.

The client should not be trusted to decide rewards, currency or important game state.

The server should validate remote requests.

RemoteEvents should have clear contracts and input validation.

ModuleScripts return reusable values or functions.

require loads a ModuleScript.

Modules can separate systems into maintainable components.

task.wait pauses execution for approximately the requested duration.

task.spawn schedules a function to run asynchronously.

RunService provides events for frame-based behavior.

Tools can be placed in a player's Backpack.

Tool.Activated fires when the player activates a Tool.

Tool.Equipped fires when a Tool is equipped.

ProximityPrompt provides an interaction prompt near an object.

PromptTriggered can be used to respond when a player interacts with a prompt.

PathfindingService can calculate paths through an environment.

A path can contain waypoints that an NPC follows.

NPC movement should handle blocked paths and failed movement.

A maintainable Roblox system should have clear responsibilities.

Server code should own authoritative gameplay state.

Client code should handle local input and presentation.

Modules should expose clear contracts.
